attributes.description: Cloud-managed identity services an environment uses, as data on the standard bases (federation domain): a ciamManagedIdentity binding (core class 167) whose ciamManagedService (770, adapter vocabulary) names the service kind. TARGET: ciamRealizes -> one of the platform's identity services (it runs on the managed service there); NEIGHBOUR: ciamPartnerOf (771) -> the integrations it is the partner side of (usually ciamManagedBy another team). Issuer vs relying party is derived from the integrations' protocol types. Cloud adapters declare each service as a ManagedService descriptor (Adapter.managed_identity: the protocols it issues to and trusts, grants, token auth methods, DPoP, signing algorithms, the cloud environments it exists in, custom domains per partition, dated sources). The planner (connectors.managed_identity) blocks a target that lacks what a served integration uses (documented unsupported: no confirmation path; not established by vendor documentation: blocks until an answered ciamUnknown of the proposed name confirms it), a service that doesn't exist in the environment's partition, and a published host the service can't keep; actions for what a render can't express. Report managed-identity. Amazon Cognito (aws adapter): Terraform aws_cognito_* and CloudFormation AWS::Cognito::*, read back from state and CLI (client secrets never read), FedRAMP boundary row, GovCloud facts. Microsoft Entra External ID (azure adapter): descriptor, public clouds only, no render (an action note).
